title: HydroJug Sport 32 oz Insulated Stainless Steel Water Bottle, Cream

reviews.title: Solid purchase
reviews.body: Nice color! I got this for my husband's birthday since he's a big pickleball player. It worked perfectly; no leaks, and he said it keeps his drinks cold. He loves that it fits in his truck's cup holder. I'd totally buy this again, it's great for everyday use or sports. The handle is a nice touch too, I noticed that's how he carries it. Overall, I think it's a good, solid water bottle, probably one of the better ones. It's a bit pricier, but my husband isn't exactly gentle with his stuff, so I think this can handle him dropping it or whatever he does with it during pickleball.😄

reviews.title: Good, big jug!
reviews.body: I love this water jug. It’s super cute, durable, and it doesn’t spill when tipped. The straw stays secured when drinking, so that’s a plus. I like the weight of it, and I love the handle on top instead of the side. It does not fit in my cup holder in my car, however, so be aware of that. Otherwise, good purchase.

reviews.title: Beautiful Design & Great for Everyday Use
reviews.body: I absolutely love the western design on this tumbler! The colors are even prettier in person, and the print looks high quality. It feels sturdy without being overly heavy, and the handle makes it comfortable to carry around.The straw is easy to drink from, and the lid fits securely without leaking during normal use. It also fits in my car’s cup holder, which is a huge plus. I’ve been using it daily for water, and it keeps my drinks cold for hours.Overall, it’s functional, cute, and well made. If you’re looking for a tumbler that’s both practical and stylish, I’d definitely recommend it.

reviews.body: Very durable. Perfect size to keep you hydrated. I put ice in with my water and ice lasted all day. Love the easy to use flip straw. Nice and lightweight. Hot pink color is my favorite.

reviews.title: Yes, you want this!
reviews.body: I’ve been using the 32 oz HydroJug for a little bit now, and I honestly love it. It’s the perfect size because it’s big enough that I’m not constantly refilling it, but it’s still easy to carry around and fits in my cup holder. It feels really well made, keeps my water cold for hours, and the handle makes it super convenient to take everywhere. It’s also easy to clean, and I haven’t had any issues with leaks. If you’re looking for a water bottle that’s practical, durable, and encourages you to drink more water throughout the day, I’d definitely recommend this one.

reviews.author: Kayla Covert

reviews.title: Great Leak Proof Travel Cup
reviews.body: Giving 4 stars due to the first delivery. I ordered the cup and the first one received was missing the straw and had visible rust in the bottom of the cup. It was clearly used and I'm assuming someone else's return.I reached out, made a return and got sent a new cup.The cup is great and keeps drinks cold over 24 hours, keeps ice about 18 hours before I notice it melting. The carry handle feels great and is easy to fold up and down. The cup isn't too heavy and the little indentions on each side help the grip of the cup while holding. The lid is easy to clean and I love that you can see through it. You do have to be cautious of what you was it with, the plastic lid can get scuffed up and scratched if washed with anything abrasive.It truly is leak proof. I can add my electrolytes to the cup and close and shake and no spills.Over all, I love the cup and have since ordered my husband and son one in different colors.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on April 8, 2026

features: STAINLESS STEEL WATER BOTTLE: Ditch dinky bottles for good with a refillable, reusable, 32oz stainless steel water bottle from Hydrojug. Minimize refilling with enough water to last you all day and crush your hydration goals with Hydrojug.

MINDFUL DESIGN: Features a grip handle for comfort, a screw-top lid for easy cleaning and ice filling, and an attached straw so you can sip directly from the bottle. The silicone base pad keeps the jug in place.
FULLY INSULATED: Our triple-vacuum insulated bottles feature a copper layer to keep your drinks cold for hours while minimizing condensation for a sweat-free exterior.

BUILT TO LAST: Carefully crafted from rust-resistant stainless steel, our shatterproof Hydrojugs can withstand just about anything. Made from food-grade BPA-free materials, have peace of mind that your bottle will be safe to use for years to come.

GREAT FOR ON-THE-GO: Featuring a thick carry loop and redesigned handle for single-handed transport and use, your Hydrojug makes the perfect travel companion. Great for the gym, school, work, sports, recreation, hiking, or anywhere you’ll ever want to go!
